about: A wild Minior comes in in its Core Form (out of a battle it is in its core, Mon_ChangeToBattleForm) and Shields Down turns it into its Meteor Form at once ('The wild Minior transformed!'), a redraw in place (ChangeForm, ov12_022593FC). The meteor floats where its own a/1/8/0 record stands it, 18 rows over the ground line by front1.lift, its shadow under it; the redraw kept the core's record, Bulbasaur's placeholder at -1, and stood the meteor on the ground.
